meta.promptText: Which face wash should I buy for oily skin in India under ₹500?

response.text:
For **oily skin**, I’d prioritize a cleanser that removes excess oil without leaving your face tight or “squeaky.” If you also get blackheads/acne, salicylic acid is particularly useful because it helps unclog pores. [www.ndtvshopping.com](https://www.ndtvshopping.com/beauty-and-grooming/best-salicylic-acid-face-washes-for-acne-prone-skin-in-monsoon-11662605?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My picks under ₹500

### [Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Cleanser]()
*₹269*

### [The Derma Co 1% Salicylic Acid Gel Face Wash]()
*₹239*

### [Deconstruct Salicylic Acid Oil Control Facewash]()
*₹263*

### [Simple Kind To Skin Refreshing Facial Wash]()
*₹336*

### [The Derma Co. Oily Skin Cleanser]()
*₹269*

**🥇 Best overall: Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Cleanser — ~₹269**  
Best if your oily skin comes with **blackheads, clogged pores or occasional acne**. Current listings put it well below ₹500, and recent Indian skincare roundups also rate it highly for oily/acne-prone skin. [www.ndtvshopping.com](https://www.ndtvshopping.com/beauty-and-grooming/best-salicylic-acid-face-washes-for-acne-prone-skin-in-monsoon-11662605?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**🥈 If you're acne-prone: The Derma Co 1% Salicylic Acid Gel Face Wash — ~₹239**  
A slightly milder salicylic-acid option. Good choice if 2% feels too strong.

**🥉 If you want oil control without aggressive exfoliation: The Derma Co Oily Skin Cleanser — ~₹269**  
A better everyday choice if your main problem is **oiliness rather than acne**.

**For sensitive/oily skin: Simple Kind To Skin Refreshing Facial Wash — ~₹204–336**  
Choose this if your skin gets irritated easily. It’s a gentler cleanser rather than an acne-treatment cleanser.

### What I'd buy

- **Oily + acne/blackheads → Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid**
- **Oily + sensitive → Simple Refreshing Facial Wash**
- **Just very oily, little acne → The Derma Co Oily Skin Cleanser**

If you tell me **your age + whether you have acne/blackheads + whether your skin is sensitive**, I can narrow it down to **one exact face wash** for you.
